control.description-key: Carrom Quiz Battle: two-player turn-based quiz carrom board

property.name: QuestionsJson
property.description-key: JSON array of questions (id, text, category, difficulty, options[4], correctIndex, hint). Invalid rows are skipped.

property.name: SessionConfigJson
property.description-key: JSON session config: { sessionId, player1, player2, targetScore, pointsPerCoin?, queenBonus? }

property.name: InitialGameStateJson
property.description-key: Optional: serialized GameState to resume (from CarromSessions snapshot). Empty starts a new game.

property.name: GameEventJson
property.description-key: Output: latest GameEvent v1.0 JSON (schemaVersion, eventId, sessionId, eventType, playerNumber, coinId, questionId, score, currentPlayer, gameStatus)

property.name: EventSequence
property.description-key: Output: monotonic counter incremented per game event. Canvas App processes GameEventJson when this changes.
